gate.title: Mobile only
gate.desc: Mia Pocket cannot be used on a PC. Open it from an Android or iOS phone and install it to your home screen.
gate.installDesc: To use the panel, install Mia Pocket to your home screen and open it from the icon (not Mia Launcher for PC).

installSteps.iosSafari:
iPhone / iPad (Safari):

  1. Tap Share (square with arrow).
  2. Choose Add to Home Screen.
  3. Open Mia Pocket from the new icon.
installSteps.iosChrome:
iPhone / iPad ({browser}):

  1. Tap Share in the browser bar.
  2. Choose Add to Home Screen or On Home Screen.
  3. Open Mia Pocket from the icon (not from the browser tab).

If it doesn’t work, open this page in Safari and repeat the steps.
installSteps.iosFirefox:
iPhone / iPad (Firefox):

  1. Menu (≡) → Share or Add to Home Screen.
  2. Confirm the Mia Pocket icon.
  3. Open the app from the icon on your home screen.

If it doesn’t work, try Safari.
installSteps.iosDefault:
iPhone / iPad:

  1. Use Share → Add to Home Screen.
  2. Open Mia Pocket from the new icon.

Recommended: Safari, Chrome or Brave.
installSteps.androidFirefox:
Android (Firefox):

  1. Menu (⋮) → Install or Add to Home screen.
  2. Open Mia Pocket from the icon, not from the browser.
installSteps.androidSamsung:
Android (Samsung Internet):

  1. Menu → Add page to → Home screen or Install app.
  2. Open Mia Pocket from the new icon.
installSteps.androidBrave:
Android (Brave):

  1. Tap Install app if the button appears.
  2. Or menu → Install app / Add to Home screen.
  3. Open Mia Pocket from the icon, not from Brave.
installSteps.androidEdge:
Android (Edge):

  1. Menu (⋯) → Install app or Add to Home screen.
  2. Open Mia Pocket from the new icon.
installSteps.androidOpera:
Android (Opera):

  1. Menu → Add to Home screen or Install app.
  2. Open Mia Pocket from the new icon.
installSteps.androidDefault:
Android (Chrome and others):

  1. Tap Install app if the button appears.
  2. Or menu (⋮) → Install app.
  3. Open Mia Pocket from the icon, not from the browser.
